## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue, if any.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. For UI changes, include screenshots and device/display details. Mark untested behavior clearly.

- [ ] Relevant tests and required CI pass.
- [ ] UI changes checked on affected screen sizes; keyboard/controller focus checked where applicable.
- [ ] Device actions, permissions, and connection failures handled explicitly.
- [ ] No credentials, private server details, game files, or local configuration included.
- [ ] Documentation reflects what works and what remains unfinished.

## Risks or follow-up

Mention compatibility changes, migrations, and any remaining testing.
